name: Obsession High
source:
For [YN], life is a relentless cycle of bad luck. Between a messy parental divorce, a dead-end job with an abusive boss, and a paycheck that barely covers the rent, surviving the day is an achievement.

To make matters worse, your roommate is the sister of your long-time bully, Peter  While she detests her brother as much as you do, her presence is a constant reminder of the torment he inflicts on you at the university.

But everything changes after a sudden, traumatic accident. The hatred in Peter’s eyes snaps into something unrecognizable. The boy who wanted to destroy you now wants to own you.

However, the shadows of the campus are crowded. Damon , a stuttering, shy student who seems to understand your pain, and Alan Orion , the upbeat and charismatic head of the Outdoor Activities Club, are watching you too. 

[From [url=https://mixtokaver.itch.io/obssession-high]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
对于[YN]来说，生活就是厄运的无情循环。混乱的父母离婚、与虐待老板的没有出路的工作，以及勉强支付房租的薪水，能熬过这一天已经是一项成就。

更糟糕的是，你的室友是你长期欺负你的彼得的妹妹，虽然她和你一样讨厌她的兄弟，但她的存在不断提醒你他在大学里对你造成的折磨。

但在一场突然的创伤性事故之后，一切都改变了。彼得眼中的仇恨瞬间变得面目全非。那个想要摧毁你的男孩现在想要拥有你。

然而校园里的影子却是拥挤不堪。达蒙（Damon），一个口吃、害羞的学生，似乎理解你的痛苦，而艾伦·奥里恩（Alan Orion），乐观而有魅力的户外活动俱乐部负责人，也在看着你。

[来自[url=https://mixtokaver.itch.io/obssession-high]itch.io[/url]]
